titleEn: Check If Array Pairs Are Divisible by k
title: 检查数组对是否可被 K 整除
summary: 把偶数长度数组配成若干对，判断能否让每对元素和都被 k 整除。
insight: 余数 r 只能与 k-r 配对；余数零必须有偶数个，当 k 为偶数时余数 k/2 也必须为偶数。
pitfalls: 负数余数要规范到零至 k-1
互补余数频次必须相等
自互补余数检查偶数性

solutions.title: 互补余数计数
solutions.idea: 用模 k 频次验证所有配对需求。
steps: 对 r=1..k-1，若 r==k-r 则 count[r] 偶数，否则 count[r]==count[k-r]

code.java: class Solution { public boolean canArrange(int[] arr,int k){int[] count=new int[k];for(int value:arr)count[((value%k)+k)%k]++;if(count[0]%2!=0)return false;for(int remainder=1;remainder<k;remainder++)if(remainder==k-remainder){if(count[remainder]%2!=0)return false;}else if(count[remainder]!=count[k-remainder])return false;return true;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun canArrange(arr:IntArray,k:Int):Boolean{val count=IntArray(k);for(value in arr)count[((value%k)+k)%k]++;if(count[0]%2!=0)return false;for(remainder in 1 until k)if(remainder==k-remainder){if(count[remainder]%2!=0)return false}else if(count[remainder]!=count[k-remainder])return false;return true} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: bool canArrange(vector<int>& arr,int k){vector<int> count(k);for(int value:arr)++count[(value%k+k)%k];if(count[0]%2)return false;for(int remainder=1;remainder<k;++remainder)if(remainder==k-remainder){if(count[remainder]%2)return false;}else if(count[remainder]!=count[k-remainder])return false;return true;} };
